items.feature: chimney-1 (F1) — the solid block over the shared wall
evidence: plan (frame …59a406b738): a solid grey block drawn on the shared wall, rows 445–459 px (z 6.75–7.14 m), the wall rows 460–469 px (z 6.47–6.75 m); the block is read (SOLID_BLOCK z 6.725–7.129) in F1B and F1C, in F1 it was read at z 6.606–7.047, partly inside the wall

readChimneys keeps a block only with a stack ≥ 0.4 m above the roof on a registered render, or on two storeys: the block is on one storey; over its projected width the LEFT render has long dark runs in 3 of 26 pixel columns and the RIGHT render in 3 of 27, the rest 2–4 px — a real stack (chimney-0) shows 36 px on nearly every column of both
F1 accepted it on the one column 2 px off its (misplaced) centre that met one of those narrow features
items.decision: not restored: the plan draws a block, no render shows a stack over it; the block is not a chimney the sources confirm, and it is not claimed absent either

items.feature: opening-0-east-5-0 (DOOR in F1, F1B, F1C, garage east wall)

evidence: the RIGHT elevation’s vertical registration is DISPUTED (SOLVER_REFUSED_LOW_HEIGHTS) in all three runs: no opening check on it counts, before or after
